Bazel 9.4.0-dzbarsky5

This security update replaces the JDK bundled with the Linux, macOS, and Windows Bazel executables on x86_64 and ARM64 with Azul Zulu OpenJDK 25.0.5.1. It fixes CVE-2026-114938 in HotSpot’s Base64 decoder on affected x86-64 processors. Run `bazel info java-runtime` to check the Bazel server JVM. Java build tools and applications that select a separate runtime need their own JDK update.

[Upstream Bazel 9.4 backport](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/32796) · [Security advisory](https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17)
